title: LLMsAgainstHate @ NLU of Devanagari Script Languages 2025: Hate Speech Detection and Target Identification in Devanagari Languages via Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning of LLMs
reasoning: The paper describes a technical system for hate speech detection and target identification using LLMs and PEFT. Although hate speech is a social and ethical concern, the paper focuses on NLP classification performance (Accuracy, F1) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks. The inclusion of a brief 'Ethical Statement' section does not qualify it according to the provided instructions.
